coverage_gap=usbvision (the f002/f003 lineage driver) does not exist anywhere in snapshots/s09 (find over the whole tree returns nothing), so that proven interface-index branch could not be re-checked in this snapshot.
coverage_gap=drivers/usb/gadget composite.c config->interface[] indexing was excluded as device-side code (host is the attacker direction), per the branch definition and prior facts; a host-controlled configfs scenario was not analyzed.
